headline: I build the backend your business runs on.
tagline: I join your backend or data team and take on the hard part: the bottleneck, the process that does not scale, the architecture nobody wants to touch. Where others see chaos, I bring order and direction.
stackLine: Python · TypeScript · Go · SQL · Linux · AWS
description: T-shaped backend engineer: Python, TypeScript and Go services, data pipelines, SQL, Linux and AWS.
about: I got into technology at a young age, but it was at 18, when I started my degree, that I really found out what I am good at. The bigger the bottleneck and the more chaotic the architecture, the more I enjoy making it work well. Freedom and resources are all it takes to turn chaos into order.

What you get is someone who starts from what the business needs, picks the simplest architecture that solves it and owns the result from design to production on Linux and AWS. Backend is where I go deepest; I also reach into data pipelines and interfaces, so work does not stall at the boundary between teams.

I was born in Santa Marta and have lived there most of my life. I like music, basketball, Linux ricing and movies, and above all I love horror stories. In my free time I go to the cinema, head to the beach, build something or simply watch a film.
